title: The full recursive walk on the sample
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

given.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
fun camelKey(s) = do {
  var parts = s splitBy "_"
  var rest = parts[1 to -1] default []
  ---
  parts[0] ++ ((rest map ((w) -> upper(w[0] default "") ++ (w[1 to -1] default ""))) joinBy "")
}
fun rewrite(v) = v match {
  case o is Object -> o mapObject ((val, key) -> { (camelKey(key)): rewrite(val) })
  case a is Array -> a map rewrite($)
  else -> v
}
---
rewrite(payload)

%dw 2.0
output application/json
fun camelKey(s) = do {
  var parts = s splitBy "_"
  var rest = parts[1 to -1] default []
  ---
  parts[0] ++ ((rest map ((w) -> upper(w[0] default "") ++ (w[1 to -1] default ""))) joinBy "")
}
fun rewrite(v) = v match {
  case o is Object -> o mapObject ((val, key) -> { (camelKey(key)): rewrite(val) })
  case a is Array -> a map rewrite($)
  else -> v
}
---
rewrite(payload)

explanation.approach: Object keys are renamed at every level; the array of phone numbers passes through the Array branch and each String inside hits `else`, so the numbers themselves are untouched.
